title: Funny Games
description: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

title: To Kill With Intrigue
description: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

title: The Last Man on Earth
description: The survivor (Vincent Price) of a global epidemic battles a race of zombie vampires in an adaptation of Richard Matheson's "I Am Legend."

title: The Decline of Western Civilization
description: Director Penelope Spheeris surveys the late-1970s Los Angeles punk scene: X, Black Flag, Fear, Germs, Catholic Discipline, Alice Bag Band.

title: The Stunt Man
description: An all-knowing director (Peter O'Toole) toys with a fugitive's (Steve Railsback) mind after making him stuntman on a movie set.

title: Serving Sara
description: A woman (Elizabeth Hurley) tries to persuade a process server (Matthew Perry) to help her turn the tables on her conniving husband (Bruce Campbell).

title: Winter Kills
description: The brother (Jeff Bridges) of an assassinated U.S. president reopens the case on a rumor of conspiracy.

title: If... Dog... Rabbit
description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.

title: The Rookies
description: An extreme sports athlete joins a mysterious special agent and her ragtag team of recruits to battle a group of deadly terrorists.

title: Compromising Positions
description: The murder of a swinging Long Island dentist puts an ex-reporter housewife (Susan Sarandon) onto a story.

title: Jobs
description: In 1976, college dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher) and technical wizard Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad) spark a revolution with the invention of the Apple computer, built in the garage of Jobs' parents.

title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
description: In the central story, Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) struggles with his inner demons and tries to maintain control until his former lover, Ava Lord (Eva Green), returns wanting his help to escape her abusive husband.

title: Sonny
description: Out of the Army, a man resumes his job as a gigolo in New Orleans and meets a call-girl who works for his mother.

title: Song to Song
description: Two struggling songwriters (Ryan Gosling, Rooney Mara), a music mogul (Michael Fassbender) and a waitress (Natalie Portman) chase success through a rock 'n' roll landscape of seduction and betrayal in Austin, Texas.

title: Bright Young Things
description: After losing the manuscript of his first novel, a penniless writer (Stephen Campbell Moore) must raise enough money to marry his superficial girlfriend (Emily Mortimer).

title: The Killing Time
description: A stranger's (Kiefer Sutherland) arrival changes a California sheriff's (Beau Bridges) plan to kill his lover's husband (Wayne Rogers).

title: Breakfast of Champions
description: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

title: The Long Good Friday
description: A Cockney crime czar (Bob Hoskins) and his mistress (Helen Mirren) answer a threat on the eve of his big deal with a U.S. mobster (Eddie Constantine).

title: Glengarry Glen Ross
description: Underhanded real estate salesmen sink to varying levels of deceit in order to sell their dubious properties.

title: Yakuza Wolf
description: A vengeful man goes after the Japanese yakuza for killing his father and must rescue his sister, who's been sold into slavery at an elite club.

title: Donnie Darko
description: An unusual teenager (Jake Gyllenhaal) follows the instructions of the 6-foot-tall rabbit which saved his life.

title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

title: Jane Got a Gun
description: With help from her boozing ex-lover (Joel Edgerton), a woman (Natalie Portman) tries to defend her injured husband (Noah Emmerich) from a vengeful outlaw (Ewan McGregor) and his gang of killers in the Old West.

title: Swords of Vengeance
description: Loyal vassals and samurai join forces to avenge the unjust execution of a lord in Japan.

title: Operation Seawolf
description: During World War II, Germany looks to its last remaining weapons and soldiers to defeat the Allies. Led by Capt. Hans Kessler, a grizzled submarine commander, the German navy sends U-boats across the sea for a mission to attack the U.S. homeland.

title: Stagecoach
description: An outlaw (John Wayne), a prostitute (Claire Trevor), a drunken doctor and assorted others go through Indian country.

title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
description: A bodyguard's assignment to safeguard a murder witness is complicated by the growing love between them.

title: Knight of Cups
description: A Los Angeles screenwriter (Christian Bale) indulges his wild side with a stripper (Teresa Palmer), a model (Freida Pinto) and a married woman (Natalie Portman).

title: Assault on Precinct 13
description: Cops and convicts join forces to defend a barren police station from a vengeance-seeking street gang.

title: The Killer Meteors
description: A powerful man seeks help from a local hero (Jackie Chan) whose secret weapon makes him invincible.

title: The Wendell Baker Story
description: An amiable con artist (Luke Wilson) helps retirement-home residents fight back against a mean-spirited nurse (Owen Wilson) who steals their money and treats them like slaves.

title: A Fantastic Fear of Everything
description: Becoming paranoid after his research into serial killers, a writer (Simon Pegg) must confront his numerous demons in order to make it to an important meeting about his screenplay.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: The owner of a haunted mansion offers a group of people reward money if they can survive a night at his scary estate.

title: A Better Tomorrow
description: A Hong Kong policeman (Leslie Cheung) blames his reformed-gangster brother (Chow Yun-Fat) for the death of their father.

title: Holy Motors
description: Driven around Paris by a loyal driver (Edith Scob), a mysterious man (Denis Lavant) dresses up in costumes and plays a number of strange, semiscripted roles.

title: Starcrash
description: A space explorer and his girlfriend try to protect Earth from devastation.

title: A Midnight Clear
description: A young GI (Ethan Hawke) and his squad have a strange encounter with Germans in the Ardennes forest, December 1944.

title: Boris Karloff: The Man Behind the Monster
description: A look at the career of Boris Karloff.

title: The BeastMaster
description: Prehistoric Darwin uses ESP with animals to save a slave girl from a sorcerer.

title: The Marksman
description: Jim is a former Marine who lives a solitary life as a rancher along the Arizona-Mexican border. But his peaceful existence soon comes crashing down when he tries to protect a boy on the run from members of a vicious cartel.

title: True Legend
description: A wealthy man goes bankrupt and becomes a patriotic hero of the streets.
